_comment: What an inflicted meteor storm costs an Age's instability budget, and how far it can reach (design 5.0, 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: anything in `agesandtheart:seals_wounds` is immune to a blast worth using,
and being properly indoors is free. A step buys all three of its dials at once -- how often a storm
gathers, how long it lasts, and how hard the bodies come in -- which want splitting into dials of
their own. Opens at 16 with the other phenomena.
